settings.visualStyle: Grounded historical reconstruction of late Eastern Han warfare leading into the Three Kingdoms era. Human-eye soldier POV, dusty earth tones, worn cloth and leather, practical Han-period helmets, spears, ji halberds, shields, crossbows, smoke, mud, fatigue, confusion and imperfect visibility. No wuxia, no fantasy, no superhero generals, no game-like FPS framing.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds. Realistic soldier POV, no narration, no dialogue, no modern cinematic polish, ambience and battlefield sound only.

movie.plotDetails: POV of an ordinary Chinese foot soldier during the late Eastern Han conflicts that lead into the Three Kingdoms era. The soldier is not a legendary hero. The experience should feel immediate, practical, fearful and physically grounded.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create a continuous short-form historical episode in 15 scenes x 8 seconds set during the Yellow Turban Rebellion in 184 CE. The entire episode must feel like human-eye POV from an ordinary Han foot soldier rather than a movie camera or a game HUD. Emphasize grounded historical reconstruction: simple cloth and leather gear, practical helmets, wooden shields, spears, ji halberds, crossbows, dust, smoke, fatigue, confusion and imperfect visibility. Show the soldier waking in camp, checking gear, marching with a unit, seeing civilians and distant smoke, receiving direction, entering fields, experiencing first arrows, taking cover behind a shield wall, pushing forward, surviving confused close action, helping a wounded comrade, observing a nearby crossbow team, resting in aftermath and marching on. No fantasy, no wuxia, no superhuman generals, no clean heroic choreography, no modern cinematic polish. No narration, no dialogue, no music.
movie.storySummary: An anonymous Han foot soldier wakes before dawn and joins his unit as it marches toward unrest during the Yellow Turban Rebellion. The road brings civilians, smoke and uncertainty. Orders redirect the unit into open fields where the first arrows fall. Under pressure the soldier crouches behind a shield line, pushes through dust and confusion, helps a wounded comrade and survives a brief chaotic clash near a village. After a short regrouping, the column continues onward into an uncertain campaign.
movie.genreDetailPrompt: Historical late Eastern Han warfare, realistic common-soldier POV, no fantasy embellishment.

scenes.title: Before Dawn in Camp

scenes.actionDescription: The soldier rises from a rough bedroll and looks through the camp as other men prepare in the dim light.

scenes.videoPrompt: Human soldier-eye POV, late Eastern Han historical realism. Wake in camp before dawn, stand up slowly, glance around rough tents, spears, bedrolls and weary soldiers preparing. Natural head movement, breathing, imperfect visibility, no staged action, ambience only.
scenes.audioDirection: No dialogue and no narration. Use only natural ambience: breathing, cloth movement, low fire crackle, footsteps, distant men moving, wind. No music.

scenes.audioDirection: No dialogue and no narration. Use only natural ambience: leather straps, wood, cloth, light armor clatter, footsteps, distant camp movement. No music.

scenes.title: The March Begins

scenes.videoPrompt: POV marching with an infantry column on a dusty road. See the backs of other soldiers, moving spear tips, shields, packs and the road underfoot. Natural walking motion, slight head movement, grounded historical realism, no cinematic hero framing.
scenes.audioDirection: No dialogue and no narration. Use only natural ambience: synchronized footfalls, cloth movement, wood and gear creaks, distant commands, carts, wind. No music.

scenes.title: Villagers Watching

scenes.imageDescription: First-person POV passing villagers and refugees beside a road in late Han China, simple clothing, carts, worried faces, dust, infantry movement in background, grounded non-fantasy historical tone.
scenes.videoPrompt: POV passes villagers and refugees at roadside. Glance briefly toward them and continue moving with the unit. Civilians should behave naturally and not pose for the camera. Dust, carts, footfalls and distant commands only.
scenes.audioDirection: No dialogue and no narration. Use only natural ambience: footsteps, cart wheels, cloth, wind, low crowd movement, distant soldiers. No music.

scenes.title: Smoke on the Horizon

scenes.imageDescription: Soldier POV looking across open farmland toward distant smoke in late Han China, trees, rough fields, haze, tension rising, practical battlefield atmosphere.
scenes.videoPrompt: POV pauses and looks toward smoke on the horizon across fields. No dramatic reveal; just a worried glance and battlefield atmosphere. Wind, distant unrest, footsteps and gear only.
scenes.audioDirection: No dialogue and no narration. Use only natural ambience: wind, distant unrest, low shouting far away, footfalls, equipment movement. No music.

scenes.title: Orders at the Crossroads
scenes.description: Messengers and an officer direct the infantry toward a threatened village.
scenes.actionDescription: At a crossroads the unit slows, and the soldier watches an officer gesture and redirect the men.
scenes.imageDescription: POV at a rural crossroads with infantry slowing, a field officer and messenger gesturing directions, soldiers waiting irregularly, simple banners, dust, historically grounded late Eastern Han warfare.
scenes.videoPrompt: POV watches officers and messengers direct the unit at a crossroads. The soldier stands among other infantry and then begins moving again. Natural body turning before the camera settles, no cinematic push-in.
scenes.audioDirection: No dialogue and no narration. Use only natural ambience: boot movement, gear noise, horses or carts in distance, wind, short indistinct orders. No music.

scenes.title: Entering the Fields
scenes.description: The formation leaves the road and advances through fields with shields ready.

scenes.videoPrompt: POV stepping off the road into fields with formation beginning to tighten. Shields and spear shafts enter the frame naturally. Use realistic uneven footing, breathing and tension. No fantasy action.
scenes.audioDirection: No dialogue and no narration. Use only natural ambience: footsteps through grass and dirt, breathing, cloth and shield movement, distant unrest. No music.

scenes.title: First Arrows
scenes.description: The first enemy arrows strike the ground and shields around the unit.
scenes.actionDescription: Arrows hit earth and shields, and the soldier instinctively lowers his posture and raises protection.
scenes.imageDescription: POV under the first incoming arrows, arrow impacts in earth and shield edges, infantry ducking, dust jumping from the ground, urgent but realistic late Han battlefield action.
scenes.videoPrompt: POV under the first incoming arrows. Arrows strike dirt and shields, the soldier lowers and raises protection instinctively. Keep the event brief, reactive and plausible. Ambience and battle sounds only.
scenes.audioDirection: No dialogue and no narration. Use only natural ambience: arrow flight, impacts into dirt and wood, footsteps, shield thumps, tense breathing, distant yelling. No music.

scenes.title: Shield Wall Under Pressure

scenes.videoPrompt: POV crouched behind a wooden shield in a tightening line. Shoulders and shields of nearby men crowd the frame. Fear, breath and pressure matter more than clear combat spectacle.
scenes.audioDirection: No dialogue and no narration. Use only natural ambience: heavy breathing, shield knocks, boots shifting, muffled shouts, arrows or impacts at a distance. No music.

scenes.videoPrompt: POV pushing forward in short steps toward low cover and broken fencing. The movement should feel difficult and uncertain, not like a victorious charge. Dust, shouts and impacts only.
scenes.audioDirection: No dialogue and no narration. Use only natural ambience: running footfalls, shield movement, shouted warnings, dust, impacts, breathing. No music.

scenes.videoPrompt: POV in close confusion at village outskirts. Visibility is poor; only fragments of friend and foe are visible. The soldier turns, ducks and struggles to see through smoke and dust. No clean choreographed duel.
scenes.audioDirection: No dialogue and no narration. Use only natural ambience: close movement, grunts, weapon impacts, dust, shield knocks, urgent confusion. No music.

scenes.audioDirection: No dialogue and no narration. Use only natural ambience: tired breathing, gear clatter, distant battle echoes, wind, light movement. No music.
